sampling: pmod(xxhash64(station_id,prediction_epoch_s,seed),10000) < fraction*10000; before threshold expansion; no label-dependent sampling
selection: equal threshold mean Brier within year, then equal mean of 2021/2022/2023

frequency_baseline.description: training sample exceedance prevalence separately for each frozen threshold

station_encoding: StringIndexer + OneHotEncoder fitted only on each sampled training fold; unknown stations rejected
class_weights: none; retain sampled natural prevalence for probability estimation
probability_postprocessing: none; threshold monotonicity diagnosed but not tuned using test
validation: full supported eligible anchors; future/role fields never model inputs
